parsed.answer: No past ticket reports this exact problem. The crash is inside PowerShell 7 itself, not Windows Terminal: PowerShell's update-notification code (UpdatesNotification.ShowUpdateNotification) calls String.PadRight with a negative width (-17) and the process fails fast. This probably happens when the window is very narrow, so that the notification banner is wider than the window. Past tickets with a similar 'Process terminated' / exit code 0x80131623 look different. #16301 was an env-var bug in Terminal, fixed in 1.19.10302.0, and #6428 was a different PowerShell crash on Ctrl+C in Write-Progress, which was a duplicate of a PowerShell issue. As workarounds, make the Terminal window or initial column count wider, or turn off the update check by setting the environment variable POWERSHELL_UPDATECHECK=Off. Update PowerShell to the latest release. If it still crashes, report it in the PowerShell repo (PowerShell/PowerShell) with the stack trace and your window size.
